verdict.rationale: jo supports scheduled automation: you give it a job and a schedule, and it runs without being asked each time. It also claims to work overnight, watching what changed and preparing your morning. That covers time-based triggers and implies some change monitoring, but nothing documents user-defined event-to-action rules. Missing for 10: explicit event-triggered rule definition (e.g. 'when X happens, do Y'), documented trigger types or conditions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
